economic_hypothesis: Subtracting the contemporaneously observed cross-sectional market move separates stock-specific order-flow shocks from broad directional movement, allowing abnormal residual dislocations to rebound or diffuse over 5-30 minutes.

factor_families.residual_three_bar_reclaim: ret3 residual < -1.5% and current ret1 residual > 0
factor_families.relative_vwap_reclaim: VWAP deviation minus same-time cross-sectional median < -0.8% and ret1 residual > 0
factor_families.residual_volume_climax_reversal: ret1 residual < -0.8%, volume rank >=90%, range position <=25%

residualization: causal session-date and decision-bar cross-sectional median using only current/past bars
